title: About Me
paragraph1: I build backend services and the cloud infrastructure they run on. At Veltra I work on Python, Go, and Node services on AWS, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and internal AI tools.
paragraph2: Before Veltra I built and ran Go, Ruby, and Python systems for logistics, fintech, medical IT, and game companies. I have been in Tokyo since 2004 and act as the bridge between overseas and Japan teams, in English and Japanese.
languagesContent: Turkish (Native), English (Near Native; TOEFL 263, 2004), Japanese (Business; JLPT Level 2, 2006)
